name: Sendou Kaya
source: [spoiler]Kaya is [url=/c1186]Erika[/url] and [url=/c1198]Iori's[/url] mother. Estimated to be over 250 years old. Has a old-fashioned approach to vampires; considers Erika a failure and despises Iori (who also despises her). Is also the master of Kiriha.[/spoiler]
